overview: Paradise Park is a family-run wildlife sanctuary in Hayle, set in 14 acres of subtropical gardens, and it’s especially strong on birds: more than 1,200 of them from around 130 species, including hundreds of parrots, penguins, flamingos and eagles. It also has red pandas, red squirrels, otters and a farm.

Its secret weapon for a Cornish holiday is JungleBarn, a big indoor play centre with giant slides and a toddler zone, so it works whatever the weather does. It’s also home to conservation work for endangered parrots and Cornwall’s own red-billed chough.

expect.title: Birds
expect.text: Scarlet and blue-throated macaws, Humboldt penguins, Caribbean flamingos in the walled garden, golden and bald eagles, kookaburras and hornbills, plus a walk-through aviary of tropical parrots.

expect.title: Mammals and farm
expect.text: Red pandas, red squirrels, Asian otters and tiny harvest mice, and a Fun Farm with miniature donkeys, pygmy goats, sheep and guinea pigs.

expect.title: JungleBarn
expect.text: Indoor soft play with giant slides and a toddler area with a ball fountain, for when the rain comes in.

expect.title: Gardens
expect.text: A signed route takes you through the Victorian walled garden, a shady jungle walk, the farm, a picnic lawn and play areas.

goodToKnow.label: Return tickets
goodToKnow.text: If you think you’ll come back, buy a cheap return ticket before you leave.

goodToKnow.label: Seasonal events
goodToKnow.text: There are special events at different times of year, including a Santa’s grotto in December.

goodToKnow.label: Food and drink
goodToKnow.text: There’s a family pub on site with a large beer garden where dogs are welcome.

week.text: A strong rainy-day plan for families around St Ives Bay, with the indoor play to fall back on. On a fine day, combine it with the huge beaches at Hayle and Gwithian.

pairWith.why: miles of golden sand across the bay
a big quiet beach on the other side of the estuary
a short climb with views over two coasts

tips: Buy your return ticket before you leave if there’s any chance you’ll be back.
